title: OKR Confidence Drift by Quarter
dataSources: Habit activity (`lifeos:habit`), streaks (`lifeos:streak`), Beeminder goals (`lifeos:beeminder`), OKRs (`lifeos:okr`), planning syncs (`lifeos:ops`).
app: Personal life-OS telemetry — Habitica quest logs, Streaks app habit chains, Beeminder goal data, and personal OKR reviews — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:okr objective_name=* confidence_score=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(confidence_score) as metric by _time objective_name
| sort 0 _time objective_name
description: Trends monthly confidence score by objective for OKR confidence.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether OKR confidence are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `objective_name` on `lifeos:okr` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly confidence score.
visualization: Line chart of monthly confidence score by objective.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how confidence score changes month by month for each objective so you can see whether OKR confidence are heading the right way.
